node.statement: Now ||S bold-dot U-U^dagger bold-dot U||<=(1+e)||S-U^dagger||||U||<=168*(65/64)e<171e, because ||U||<=2. Since U^dagger bold-dot U=J, the triangle inequality gives ||mu(S,U)-J||<(84+171)e=255e<=260e, proving the claimed left-inverse defect without invoking any pending sibling.
